description: This file defines the LeaveAssignmentService class responsible for handling leave assignment logic within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for assigning leave, saving leave requests, checking leave overlaps, and workflow management.

classes.name: LeaveAssignmentService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing leave assignment processes including validation, request creation, and workflow handling within the HRM system.

methods.name: assignLeave
methods.description: Main method to assign leave to an employee, performs validation and saves the leave request.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Handles the creation and persistence of a new leave request, manages related comments, notifications, and workflow events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a leave request based on date and workflow context.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether leave balance can be exceeded in this service.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForAssignAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow state machine item corresponding to the 'ASSIGN' action for leave requests.
